requirement: Requirement: Character must be a confirmed believer in the corresponding Church. Losing faith (GM discretion) temporarily suspends blessings until reconciliation.

entries.effect: Dream Lucidity, Concealment. Most divination fails against you.
Underwater Breathing. Stay underwater 10 hrs; +3 HT vs pressure.
Bury in soil to regenerate. Fatal wounds heal; revive from death.
Herculean strength & catlike reflexes. +3 ST, +3 DX, +3 HT.
Expert in mysticism. +5 to all occult/knowledge skills.
Possession impossible. Burn evil near you (1d6/round).
Beyonder item affinity. Rapid ID; curses negated.
